title: Welded joints.
officialText:
All joints shall be welded with a welding procedure developed and qualified in accordance with the
ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section IX (Welding and Brazing Qualifications) or in accordance with AWS B2.1
Specifications for Welding Procedure and Performance Qualification.
